verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only conventional e-services: search, e-filing, status tracking, journals, cause lists, registers and fees. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. A government IP office portal could plausibly offer AI-assisted search or recommendations, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
